message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you are eager to prove yourselves as a great long-term partner. Our options give you a clear way to do that: a tighter quality commitment and no chargeback per complaint, at a price we can approve.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

Option A is the package we can approve. Your offer sits well above what we have paid for this bracket, and Option A pairs a firm quality commitment with a unit price in line with our own order history.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

As another option, let's agree on 46.50 EUR for the 1500 ppm and zero chargebacks, and we can get this moving. This alternative is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
